resources.string: Start the server on your computer with npm start and enter the address it prints, e.g. 192.168.1.20:3000. Your phone must be on the same Wi‑Fi (or the server must be reachable from the internet).

Checklist:
• Is npm start running on your computer?
• Are the phone and computer on the same Wi‑Fi?
• Use the computer's LAN IP (shown in the server log), not localhost.
• Is a firewall blocking port 3000?
